input: Read /data/sales.csv with columns: region, product, amount. Compute total amount per region (like SQL GROUP BY region, SUM(amount)). Print results as 'region: total' sorted by total descending.

tool_calls: ls -l /data/sales.csv; command -v ruby; command -v node; command -v awk; head -n 5 /data/sales.csv
awk -F',' 'NR > 1 {sub(/\r$/, "", $3); totals[$1] += $3} END {for (region in totals) printf "%s: %.10g\n", region, totals[region]}' /data/sales.csv | sort -t':' -k2,2nr -k1,1
